capabilities: Display vault statistics (notes, files, attachments, links) in the status bar
Cycle through statistics by clicking the status bar item
Show all statistics at once via hover or a CSS snippet
Report word count and total vault size
extras: Counts exclude comment sections; a changelog documents fixes for renamed/deleted files and admonition handling.
intentEvidence: Status bar item with vault statistics including the number of notes, files, attachments, and links.
problem: Obsidian's status bar only shows statistics for the current note, with no view of counts across the whole vault.
summary: Status bar item that shows vault-wide statistics such as note, file, attachment, and link counts.
